review.summary: The change adds services.discord.mention_id, validates it with a strict anchored 17-20 ASCII digit regex after trimming (string or int), appends "\n<@id>" and reserves room for it in the 1800-character truncation. It ships thorough Pest tests for valid, empty, malicious and truncation cases and updates .env.example, both ops docs, the class PHPDoc and the CHANGELOG. It is lean, secure and within scope, so I would approve it as is.
